messages:
Ruth (People Ops): @channel Quick note: Tomorrow (Thu Sep 9) we'll run a building evacuation drill at 10:15AM across the Boston office. It's a drill only, no need to panic. Please review the plan and pick your role if you're a floor marshal (form link): https://tinyurl.com/bos-evac-drill

Derek (Facilities): Doors will automatically unlock at 10:10 for faster egress. Meeting rooms will show an 'evac drill' banner. Please leave personal items but take your badge. Assembly point: City Hall Park (east lawn).

Maya (Security): Security will make a live PA announcement at 10:15 and run through accountability checks at the assembly point. If you're a visitor host, escort guests out and log them on the visitor clipboard.

Holly: I'm remote that day but managing our team. Do managers need to mark themselves somewhere?

Ruth (People Ops): Managers should confirm team headcounts in the post-drill form. If any team members are remote, note that in the form so we don't trigger follow-ups. Form link in first message.

Irfan: Any folks with mobility needs? I use a cane; plan to exit via service elevator. Is that allowed during the drill?

Derek (Facilities): If you need the service elevator, coordinate with Security before 10:00. We'll station an escort at the elevator bank. Please DM Maya to confirm.

safety-bot: safety-bot reminder: If you notice smoke or real emergency instead of drill, call 911 and then post "REAL_EMERGENCY" in this channel immediately.

Holly: Will there be a brief retrospective? I want to include notes into our team retro.

Ruth (People Ops): Yes 90-minute post-drill debrief at 11:00 in Conf Room C (optional). We'll collect improvement items in a short anonymous form. Calendar invite will be sent to floor marshals and managers.

calendar-bot: calendar-bot created event: "Boston Evacuation Drill" Sep 9 10:10-11:15 (location: City Hall Park).

Maya (Security): Quick checklist: badge, closed-toe shoes, water bottle. Leave pets at home. If you bring a guest, add their name here now for pre-clearance.

Irfan: Thanks 94 I'll DM Maya to confirm elevator escort.

Ruth (People Ops): TL;DR: Drill 10:15AM, assembly at City Hall Park, floor marshals fill form, accessibility elevators via Security escort, debrief 11:00. Questions here or DM me. :white_check_mark:
